facts.statement: Ponerosteus is a dubious genus of an extinct archosauromorph that was originally thought to be a dinosaur.
facts.quote: Ponerosteus is a dubious genus of extinct archosauromorph from the Late Cretaceous (Cenomanian-aged) Korycanar Formation of the Czech Republic that was initially identified as a species of the dinosaur Iguanodon.

facts.statement: The only known species in the genus is Ponerosteus exogyrarum.
facts.quote: The type, and currently only, species is P. exogyrarum.

facts.statement: The holotype, a cast of a tibia found near Holubice, was first named Iguanodon exogirarum by Antonín Frič in 1878.
facts.quote: The holotype, NAMU Ob 40, consisting solely of an internal cast of a tibia, was discovered near Holubice, Kralupy nad Vltavou, and was first identified as a dinosaur, which was named "Iguanodon exogirarum" (later "Iguanodon exogyrarum") by Antonín Frič in 1878.

facts.statement: Frič later renamed the specimen Procerosaurus in 1905, not realizing the name was already taken.
facts.quote: He later (1905) renamed it Procerosaurus, unaware that this name was already in use (von Huene, 1902) for what is now a synonym of Tanystropheus.

facts.statement: The name Ponerosteus translates to "bad" or "useless bone," reflecting the poor condition of the fossil.
facts.quote: The name Ponerosteus can be translated as "bad", "worthless", or "useless bone", which describes the fragmentary nature of the holotype.

facts.statement: The holotype fossil is currently displayed at the National Museum in Prague.
facts.quote: the holotype has since been put on display at the National Museum in Prague.

facts.statement: Ponerosteus is now classified within Archosauromorpha rather than as a dinosaur.
facts.quote: Although initially identified as being a dinosaur belonging to the genus Iguanodon, Ponerosteus is currently classified within Archosauromorpha.

facts.statement: Ponerosteus lived during the Late Cretaceous (Cenomanian) in the Korycanar Formation of the Czech Republic.
facts.quote: Ponerosteus is a dubious genus of extinct archosauromorph from the Late Cretaceous (Cenomanian-aged) Korycanar Formation of the Czech Republic

facts.statement: The animal lived approximately 96 million years ago during the Cenomanian stage of the Cretaceous.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 96 millones de años, en el Cenomaniense.

facts.statement: The holotype is apparently the inner surface of a tibia belonging to an animal that may or may not be a dinosaur.
facts.quote: aparentemente es la cara interna de una tibia de un animal que podría ser o no un dinosaurio.

facts.statement: The Paleobiology Database lists the parent group of Ponerosteus as Ornithopoda.
Ponerosteus is classified within the class Ornithischia.

rejected.statement: George Olshevsky renamed the specimen Ponerosteus exogyrarum in 2000 and classified it as a dubious name.
rejected.quote: NAMU Ob 40 was renamed Ponerosteus exogyrarum (species name amended) by George Olshevsky in 2000, and Olshevsky considered Ponerosteus to be a nomen dubium.
